checks.name: Synthetic browser Home inspection and signed-out product/CTA states
checks.result: Zero page errors and horizontal overflow; #f3f8f6 canvas, 16px desktop intro-card gap (mobile retains -28px hero overlap), 24px hero margins and desktop menu starts below the hero; footer order and colored action labels/colors retained; signed-out state keeps product information above and a single sign-in action below in Due for Review. Arabic RTL was inspected on mobile and desktop. API responses are intercepted synthetic fixtures.

limitations: This focused UI run is Home-only; full-route axe, keyboard, zoom and live-identity gates remain separate.
No real learner data, Drive access or live authentication was used.
